chapter.verse: Khrisa Jesu' sawltak dingin Pasian' deihna tawh hong kisamkhia keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Sosthenes in

eite leh mun citeng pan amah a muang mite ii Topa ahi, i Topa Jesu Khris' min a suangte khempeuh tawh mi siangtho ahikhawm dingin sapkhiatna a ngah, Khris Jesu' sunga kisiansuah, Corinth khua-a om Pasian' pawlpi, kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Khris Jesu' tungtawnin note hong kipia Pasian' hehpihna hangin note' adingin ka Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko tawntung hi.
Ama' hangin thugenna namkim leh thutheihna namkim tawh na kicing uh a,
Khris thu teci panna zong note lakah kiptak om khin ahih zah khatin
i Topa Jesu Khris hong kilaak ding kal ngakin na om laitakun hehpihna gah na ngah loh uh om lo hi.
Amah in i Topa Jesu Khris' ni ciangin kawkbaanglo na hih nadingun a tawp dongin note hong kipsak ding hi.
Ama' Tapa ahi, i Topa Jesu Khris tawh kikholhkhopna ah note hong sam Pasian pen a muanhuai ahi hi.
Sanggamte aw, note khempeuh na thugen uh na kikhatsak nadingun leh note' lakah kikhenkhapna om lo-in lungsim leh tupna kibangin na kithukhat nadingun i Topa Jesu Khris' min tawh kong thum hi.
A hang pen sanggamte aw, note' lakah kitot kiselna om cih thu Chloe mite' tungtawnin teltak hong kiko khin hi.
Ka cihnopna ah note in, “Kei, Paul' pawl,” ahihkeileh, “Kei, Apollos' pawl,” ahihkeileh, “Kei, Cephas' pawl,” ahihkeileh, “Kei, Khris' pawl,” na ci tek uh hi.
Khris kikhenkham zenzen ahi hiam? Note' ading Paul kikhailum ahi hiam? Ahihkeileh Paul' min tawh kibaptize na hi uh hiam?
Note' lakah Crispus leh Gaius losiah kuamah dang kong baptize loh Pasian' tungah ka lungdam hi.
Hikeileh keima' min tawh kibaptize a ci nuam na om ding uh hi.
(Stephanas-te innkuan zong ka baptize a, tua bansiah ka baptize dang om/omlo cih ka tel nawnkei hi).
Kei' tunga Khris' hong sawl pen baptize vai hilo-in Lungdamna Thu tangko ding vai hizaw a, tua zong thugen siamna masuat ding hilo hi. Hi hileh Khris' singlamteh thu pen a hawmpi tawh kibang ding hi.
Tua hi a, singlamteh thu pen a kisia ding mite' ading a haihuai thu ahih hangin hotkhiat a ngah eite' adingin Pasian' vangliatna ahi hi.
Tua hangin hih bangin kigelh hi: “Mipilte' pilna ka susia ding a,thutheite' thutheihna bangmahlo ka suah ding hi.”

Mipil a cih koi ah om ahi hiam? Laisiam mi koi ah om ahi hiam? Hih khanghun sunga thulela kidot kidawn a siam mi koi ah om ahi hiam? Leitung pilna teng Pasian in a haihuai thu suaksak khin hilo ahi hiam?
A hang pen Pasian' pilna sungah leitung mite in amau' pilna tawh Pasian thei zolo ahih khit nungsang, Pasian in a haihuai komau' thutangkona tungtawnin a um mite hotkhiat ding lungkim thukim hi.
A hang pen Jew mite in kihilna lim kal uh a, Greek mite in pilna kal uh hi.
Himah taleh kote in a kikhailum Khris thu ka tangko uh a, tua pen Jew mite' ading palkhaktheih thu leh Gentile mite' ading a haihuai thu ahi hi.
Jew ahi-a Gentile ahi zongin sapkhiatna a ngah mite' ading ahihleh Khris pen Pasian' vangliatna leh Pasian' pilna ahi hi.
A hang pen Pasian' haina mite sangin pilvaizaw a, Pasian' thanemna mite sangin thakhauhzaw hi.
Sanggamte aw, note hong kisapkhiatna thu lungngai un. Cilesa mit tawh en lehang note pen mipil tam lo, ulian zong tam lo, milian nama piang zong na tam kei uh hi.
Himah taleh Pasian in mipilte a maizumsak nadingin leitunga a haivaite teel a, mihatte a maizumsak nadingin leitunga a thanemte teel hi.
Pasian in thupi a kicite a hepkhiat nadingin leitunga tualniamte leh a kisimmawhte bek hilo, bangmah manlo mite nangawn teel hi.
Tua pen Pasian' mai-ah mihing a kisial kuamah a om loh nading ahi hi.
Ama' hangin Khris Jesu sungah a om na hi uh a, amah pen eite' ading Pasian' hong piak pilna hong suakin eite' dikna, sianthona leh tatkhiatna hong suak hi.
Tua hi a, lai kigelh a om bangin, “A kisial mi peuhmah Topa' hang bekin kisial ta hen.”
